selected_script.angle: Clearing cluttered dish soap, scrubbing brushes, and kitchen towels from the sink ledge onto the side of the refrigerator using magnetic metal racks
selected_script.hook: Stop letting slimy dish soap bottles and wet sponges puddle up the ledge behind your kitchen sink.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Show one real daily pain point through a close-up detail of a slimy, wet puddle of water around dish soap bottles and a wet sponge on a narrow kitchen sink ledge. No product and no rescuer. 1.5-3s: An absurd adult family rescuer (Grandpa wearing a formal tuxedo and swim goggles) enters carrying the exact matte black rectangular carbon steel magnetic spice rack from the first frame, takes it directly to the side of the refrigerator next to the sink, snaps it on, and says 'No more puddles!'. 3-6s: Quickly show the product as the direct solution: placing the soap bottle into the rack and hanging a sponge brush from the detachable metal hooks at the bottom edge. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result with spice jars organized in the rack. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or exaggerated functions. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material, side structure, edge shape, texture, and visible details. Use the function reference image only to understand the real product usage. Do not invent new functions. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, clear, low-risk, and product-focused.
